I realize this has turned into a review of the Anker but I hate reading poor reviews of a product and wonder what product ended up working for that person... so if you can spare a few more dollars, buy the Anker $27 vs $70 . If you are strapped on cash, the DKnight will do and hopefully yours lasts longer than 3 months with no issues.

PRODUCT: LG Electronics LAP240 Sound Plate 100W Slim 4.1 Surround Sound Speaker System with Built-In Sub Woofer and Bluetooth. REVIEW: I purchased this LG sound system recently from Amazon as having purchased one of the TV models a few months ago that was listed as compatible I found that while the TV the 50 inch model has a spectacular picture but terrible sound. The reason for the poor quality is due specifically to the fact that the speaker has to be mounted on the back of the TV to keep its slim form factor. So while the TV is beautiful to look at all the sound that comes from it is coming out the back speaker and being reflected off the wall back at the listener. It makes the sound seem muted and dull. So again, I purchased this sound plate because the TV can sit on it and come out from all sides of the set. Of course there has to be a 34 but 34 coming up... But while hook up can be done wirelessly or wired and it does come with an optical wire the bass is very deep and tends to drown out much of the spoken work. There are 3 sound settings to choose from but they really sound very much alike. It is a very definite improvement but far too over priced for what you get. One last detail it comes with its own remote control that is about the size of a credit card in ALL dimensions and tends to get lost very easily. Would I recommend it to a friend, possibly. Is is worth the price, definitely not. Is it better than the stock sound that comes out of the LG, yes. So I rated it in the middle and leave it up to you to decide.
